title: How it is tested
summary: Four suites against fake provider CLIs, no cloud touched: test_column_display 15, test_cloudctl 101, test_discover 30, test_xtp 98 (244 checks). test_xtp covers add-only per provider, REMOVE naming, NO CHANGE for an Azure rule already as wanted, the read-only HOME path, AWS_PAGER, and --add-only on firewall reconcile. Four deliberate breakages (add-only off for named rules, AWS_PAGER unset, the hint removed, the shared-scope account and project check removed) were each caught. The missing-CLI checks run on a PATH holding only the tools a run needs, with REXX_PATH set, because hosts such as the autobuild runner have the real aws installed. Run: LOGGING_HOME=packages/oorexx_logging_v0.7 bash tests/autobuild_run.sh.
